config.hypothesis: Learn a workload-level categorical depth alongside token-dependent sampling coordinates; lower depths trade quality for executed compute. Quality-only depth objective, no arbitrary compute penalty.

hypothesis: Learn a workload-level categorical depth alongside token-dependent sampling coordinates; lower depths trade quality for executed compute. Quality-only depth objective, no arbitrary compute penalty.
mechanism: Each depth executes the first d frozen normalization blocks, resampling the same weight curve with endpoints0,1. Frozen backbone originally trained with4 blocks: reduced-depth distribution shift is a limitation. Depth2 has no interior coordinate or coordinate updates.
learning: 600 common tuning minibatches per seed. Each branch d>2 optimizes coordinate CE independently with Adam lr0.003; every depth sees identical examples. Three categorical logits optimize sum(softmax(logits)*detached branch CE) with Adam lr0.03. Quality-only objective, no compute penalty. Inference argmax chooses one depth for the entire workload/request; no per-token skipping.
selection: At each round save all branches and logits. Keep validation-best profile per depth. Keep validation-best learned argmax policy across rounds0..3, with old4-step incumbent as fallback. All choices freeze before confirmation.
confirmation: 256 fresh65-byte windows [1053774,1070414); one primary paired contrast selected policy vs incumbent. Other profiles/latencies descriptive.
promotion: Same useful-effect gate: every paired seed improves, mean CE gain >=0.02 nats/byte, paired95 upper bound below0. No automatic quality promotion for cheaper layers.
accounting: 3 reused backbone seeds; 36 router checkpoints and12 selector checkpoints. Training evaluates all3 depth branches; serving runs one branch. Full backbone storage remains allocated. Local CPU FP32 batch1 latency measured on validation, not extrapolated to GPUs.
canary: Exact4-step optimizer and forward parity with parent; actual block counts via normalization hooks; orderedpositions; same-shape causal intervention; FP64 three-step router finite difference <1e-7; exact categorical expected-loss derivative.
